subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 09, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 09, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We are excited to share with you the latest updates from the AcreetionOS project. As we continue to work towards creating a community-driven, user-friendly Linux distribution based on Arch Linux, we are committed to keeping you informed about our progress.

In the past week, we have been following the progress of Asahi Linux 7.3, a Linux distribution for Apple devices. The Asahi Linux developers have released a new progress report, which you can find on their website. We are impressed by their dedication to creating a high-performance Linux distribution for Apple devices.

In other news, we have been exploring the concept of Amutable Foundations: A Technical Overview. This technical overview provides a comprehensive look at the foundations of Amutable, a new approach to software development. We believe that this concept has the potential to revolutionize the way we think about software development and are excited to learn more about it.

The X.Org Developers Conference (XDC) took place recently, and videos from the event are now available on YouTube. We encourage you to check out the videos and learn more about the latest developments in the world of open-source software.

On the AcreetionOS side, we have been working on updating our newsletter and archive systems. Our latest commit, intelligence sync: newsletter + archive + wiki guides + feed 2026-11-08-0310, has made significant improvements to our newsletter and archive systems. We are excited to share these updates with you and look forward to your feedback.

We are also excited to announce that our news section has been updated with the latest news from the world of Linux and open-source software. You can find the latest news on our website, including the progress report from Asahi Linux 7.3 and the availability of videos from XDC 2026.

As always, we want to thank our community for their continued support and enthusiasm. Your feedback and contributions are invaluable to us, and we look forward to hearing from you.

In the coming weeks, we will be working on new features and updates for AcreetionOS. We will keep you informed about our progress and look forward to sharing our updates with you.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We are excited to continue working together to create a user-friendly Linux distribution based on Arch Linux.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
